description: Under full semantics, every comprehension instance is true whenever its chosen relation variable is not free in its defining formula.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.full_comprehension.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (n X : ℕ) (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.Formula L)
  (hfresh : (n, X) ∉ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.freeRelation φ) (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HenkinSemantics.comprehensionInstance n X φ)
